captions.instagram:
The Gloria Tornado.

A hot summer day in a small Texas town. I'm six, sitting in the back of a forest green Pontiac next to my two-year-old brother, and we're late to meet my grandma at the zoo in Houston. Of course we're late.

We don't get far down the dirt road. A memory from the backseat.

New essay on Not Plain. Read it at the link in bio.
